turns.user_utterance: I can't get into my account—everything keeps getting rejected!
turns.assistant_response: I’m sorry—when you say everything gets rejected, do you mean your login/sign-in is failing, or that an identity verification step is being declined?

turns.user_utterance: The verification step is being declined!
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—if the verification step is being declined, this is usually related to identity checks. Could you tell me what message or reason you see when it’s rejected (e.g., “not approved”, “doesn’t match”, or “failed verification”)? Also, was it declined for document upload or for a selfie/biometric check?

turns.user_utterance: It says “doesn’t match” and it was for the selfie check.
turns.assistant_response: Thanks—since the selfie check says “doesn’t match,” this points to an identity verification mismatch. Can you tell me whether you’re using a different phone/camera than usual, and whether the selfie lighting was bright and face clearly visible (no blur/glasses/filters)?

turns.user_utterance: Same phone, but the lighting was terrible and my face was blurry.
turns.assistant_response: Got it—if the selfie was blurry and the lighting was poor, the system may fail the match and decline verification. Please retry the selfie verification in a well-lit, well-focused area (avoid filters, hold the camera steady, and make sure your face fills the frame). If you still see “doesn’t match,” tell me what device you’re using (iOS/Android) and whether you were asked to re-upload a new selfie or provide a different document.
